## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical result and why the change is needed.

## Scope and traceability

- Related issue or requirement IDs:
- Platforms tested:
- Compatibility evidence, if applicable:

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo xtask lint`
- [ ] `cargo xtask test`
- [ ] Packaged `--self-test` for packaging/runtime changes
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when behavior changed

## Clean-room declaration

- [ ] No proprietary Adobe source, binary implementation detail, artwork, text, LUT, preset, translation, or other copyrighted asset was copied.
- [ ] Compatibility claims are backed by attributable public documentation or reproducible clean-room observations.
- [ ] Private fixtures are referenced only by non-sensitive hashes and are not committed.
- [ ] Unknown or unverified behavior is clearly labelled and does not enable writable `.prproj` support.
